channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: JetBlue cancels Vero Beach to JFK route, final flights Sept. 9
item.description: JetBlue is canceling its flight route between Vero Beach Regional Airport and New York's JFK Airport, with the last flights operating on Sept. 9. item.title: Republican state Rep. Fabian Basabe ordered to pay $450,000 in sexual harassment case
item.description: A Leon County jury found Republican state Rep. Fabian Basabe liable for sexual harassment, battery and defamation, ordering him to pay $450,000 to three plaintiffs.

item.title: Florida Rep. Angie Nixon gets September trial date for Capitol sit-in charges
item.description: Democratic state Rep. Angie Nixon will stand trial the week of Sept. 21 on misdemeanor charges stemming from her May sit-in outside Gov. Ron DeSantis' Capitol office.

item.title: Alex Vindman raises $8.5 million in Democratic Senate primary race
item.description: Retired Army Lt. Alex Vindman raised $8.5 million during the second quarter, pushing his total receipts above $16 million in the Democratic primary for U.S. Senate.

item.title: Republican gubernatorial candidate James Fishback faces residency challenge in court
item.description: Republican gubernatorial candidate James Fishback will defend his eligibility to remain in the primary next week as an opponent challenges whether he meets Florida's seven-year residency requirement.

item.title: Declassified report shows Chinese actor downloaded Florida voter registration data in 2022
item.description: A declassified intelligence report reveals that a Chinese cyber actor downloaded publicly available Florida voter registration information from commercial websites in 2022.

item.title: Lionel Messi photographed bathing Lamine Yamal as baby nearly two decades before World Cup final matchup
item.description: A Barcelona photographer captured images of teenage Lionel Messi bathing infant Lamine Yamal in 2007 for a charity calendar. The two players will now face each other in Sunday's World Cup final when Argentina plays Spain.

item.title: Argentina defeats England 2-1 with late rally to advance to World Cup final
item.description: Argentina scored two goals in the final minutes to overcome England 2-1 in the World Cup semifinals on Wednesday. The defending champions will face Spain in the final on Sunday in East Rutherford, New Jersey.

item.title: Major League Baseball restricts dugout iPad use to prevent AI from making in-game decisions
item.description: Major League Baseball made custom tabs on dugout iPads inaccessible to teams starting Wednesday night. MLB said the tabs had expanded iPad use beyond their originally intended purpose to include recommendations regarding substitutions and pitch calling.

item.title: World Cup final security ramped up in New Jersey with Secret Service perimeter for President Trump's attendance
item.description: The World Cup final on Sunday in New Jersey will include a beefed-up Secret Service perimeter, with President Trump attending the trophy presentation. The final is designated a Level 1 Special Event with the highest possible security designation.

item.title: Flip City Gym and Cheer gymnasts from Treasure Coast earn top 15 national finish, qualify for Junior Olympics
item.description: Three young gymnasts from Flip City Gym and Cheer competed as one unit on the national stage last month, each having found their way to the sport through different paths. item.title: Alex Vindman raises $8.5 million in Florida Senate race as Ashley Moody touts poll lead
item.description: Democratic Senate candidate Alex Vindman expanded his fundraising advantage during the second quarter, raising $8.5 million and pushing his total receipts above $16 million.

item.title: Democratic Rep. Angie Nixon to stand trial in September for Capitol sit-in charges
item.description: State Rep. Angie Nixon will face trial the week of Sept. 21 on misdemeanor charges from her May sit-in outside Gov. Ron DeSantis' Capitol office.

item.title: Defense Secretary Hegseth backs Blue Angels low-altitude Pensacola flyover despite safety concerns
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is encouraging low-altitude military flyovers after a Blue Angels jet flew so low over a Pensacola beach that chairs and tents went flying.

item.title: Declassified intelligence records show Chinese actor downloaded Florida voter registration data
item.description: Records released by the White House show a Chinese cyber actor downloaded publicly available Florida voter registration information from commercial websites in 2022.

item.title: Republican gubernatorial candidate James Fishback faces Florida residency challenge in court
item.description: Republican gubernatorial candidate James Fishback will defend his eligibility to remain in the primary as an opponent argues he does not meet Florida's seven-year residency requirement.

item.title: Florida beachgoers describe Blue Angels low flyover as once-in-a-lifetime experience
item.description: Alexandra Belcher, a 34-year-old Florida beachgoer, called the Blue Angels flyover a once-in-a-lifetime experience despite the unusual proximity of the aircraft.

item.title: Martin County faces $2.1 billion transportation funding gap as needs outpace available money
item.description: Martin County is facing a $2.1 billion transportation funding shortfall, and the gap between what the county needs and what it can afford could shape how residents get around for decades.

item.title: Fort Pierce woman wins $5 million on $20 Florida Lottery scratch-off ticket
item.description:
